theater: 泗水郡蘄縣大澤鄉至陳郡

battle.name: 大澤鄉起義
battle.theater: 泗水郡蘄縣大澤鄉至陳郡
battle.brief: 公元前二〇九年七月，泗水郡蘄縣大澤鄉，屯戍漁陽的九百名秦軍戍卒因暴雨阻路、誤期當斬，陳涉、吳廣殺尉奪旗、斬木為兵，旬月之間聚眾數萬攻入陳郡淮陽，陳涉自立為楚王號張楚。卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔是希臘重裝步兵的全覆面頭盔，七世紀中期定型，與楚地無涉；義兵徒手持矛、揭竿為旗，無甲胄。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 公元前二〇九年七月，泗水郡蘄縣大澤鄉的九百名戍卒與秦朝中央政府開火。交戰的一方是秦帝國的郡縣徵發體系與屯戍序列，另一方是由陳涉、吳廣臨時拉起、旬月之間席捲楚地的起義眾。秦方的編制極為整齊：全國兵分郡兵、邊軍、宿衛與南方戍卒四類，徵發自郡縣，由郡守、郡尉、縣令、縣尉分層管轄，出兵之後由將軍與校尉統率；這批將赴漁陽屯戍的九百人，隸屬泗水郡的徵發序列，由兩名「尉」率領，陳涉、吳廣身在其中充任屯長。秦廷的決策層在咸陽，丞相府與掌中尉之權的趙高傳達命令，郡縣官員就地處理徵兵、押運與糧秣，這套體系的效率極高，卻也使最底層的個人承受了全部的風險：期限一失，無人可以申辯。起義方則完全沒有編制。陳涉、吳廣殺死兩尉、奪取兵符之後自稱將軍，靠「徒屬」即願意跟隨的鄉里子弟作戰，沿途把同行者裹進隊伍充實人數，全軍沒有固定的番號、沒有糧秣儲備、沒有後方基地，能夠維繫，靠的只是「王侯將相寧有種乎」這類號召與陳勝的名聲。兩套體系的差別，正是這場戰爭從第一刻起便註定的結局。
countriesEn: In July 209 BC, the nine hundred conscripts at Daze township in Qi county of the Si River commandery fired on the central government of the Qin state. One side was the levy and garrison system of the Qin empire, the other was a body of insurgents hastily raised by Chen Sheng and Wu Guang which, within a single month, swept the lands of Chu. The Qin establishment was exceptionally tidy. The troops of the empire fell into four classes, the levies of the commanderies and counties, the frontier army, the palace guard and the garrisons of the south; they were levied by the commanderies and counties and governed in layers by the commandery governors, the commandery commandants, the county magistrates and the county commandants, and once mustered they were led by generals and colonels. The nine hundred men bound for the garrison of Youyang belonged to the levy series of the Si River commandery and were led by two officers styled wei, with Chen Sheng and Wu Guang serving among them as company commanders. The decisions of the Qin were taken at Xianyang, transmitted by the office of the chancellor and by Zhao Gao, who held the authority of the commandant of justice, while the local officials handled the mustering, the escorting and the grain on the spot. That system was extremely efficient, and it was also the reason that the man at the bottom of it bore the whole of the risk: once the deadline was missed there was no one to argue with. The insurgents had no establishment at all. After killing the two wei and taking the tokens of command, Chen Sheng and Wu Guang called themselves generals, fought with the tu-shu, the villagers who chose to follow them, and swelled their numbers by drawing the people of the road into the column. The army had no fixed designations, no stores of grain and no rear base; what held it together was nothing but a call such as 'are kings, marquises, generals and ministers born of a special breed?' and the name of Chen Sheng. The difference between the two systems decided the outcome of the war from its first hour.
people: 史記為這場起義留下的人不多，但每個名字都標出一個關鍵位置。陳涉，字涉，陽城人（今河南登封），少時為人耕田，貧而無業，後來在隊伍裡屢次說起「燕雀安知鴻鵠之志」，是把無名戍卒變成首義者的那根火種。吳廣與他同鄉同里，二人平日以同鄉相與，在被雨困於大澤鄉的那幾夜，議定「舉大計亦死，等死，死國可乎」；吳廣又故意自請為屯長、當眾辱罵尉，逼得尉笞打自己，趁拔劍起身之際奪劍殺尉，陳涉隨即上前同殺另一名尉，兩人由是奪得兵符、聚齊全營。秦方留下姓名的是那兩名被殺的尉，以及郡縣的守令與守丞：兩人失蹤或逃亡，使陳郡治所在旬月之間無主。更上層是秦二世與趙高，政令自咸陽貫徹到每一個鄉里；扶蘇、蒙恬已被賜死，蒙恬所領的三十萬北軍遂無主帥，邊軍一旦有事便無所調度。陳涉既起，隨即分遣周文西向關中、武臣與張耳、陳餘北略趙地、韓廣往燕地；秦嘉與孔鮑亦各聚眾在泗水一帶響應，陳涉的使者還往各縣宣示。起義由一次夜襲擴散成一張網的走向，就寫在這些名字的分佈裡。
peopleEn: Only a few names survive for this rising in the Records of the Grand Historian, but each of them marks a key position. Chen Sheng, courtesy name She, was a man of Yangcheng, in what is now Dengfeng in Henan; he had worked as a farmhand in youth, was poor and had no trade, and later, in the ranks, spoke again and again of how the sparrow could never know the ambition of the swan, and he was the spark that turned an unnamed conscript into the man who raised arms first. Wu Guang was a fellow villager of the same town; the two had been close from childhood as men of one locality, and in the nights when the rain kept them at Daze they settled the question that to rise in arms was also death, but to die in a rising was death with a purpose. Wu Guang then deliberately offered to be made company commander and openly insult the officer, provoking him to beat him, and when the officer drew his sword Wu Guang rose, seized it and killed him, and Chen Sheng came up at once and killed the second officer; the two took the tokens of command and called the whole camp together. The names recorded on the Qin side are those of the two officers killed and of the magistrate of the city and the assistant officer, who were away or fled, so that for a full month the seat of the commandery of Chen had nobody in command. Higher up there were the Second Emperor and Zhao Gao, whose orders ran from Xianyang down to every village; Fusu and Meng Tian had already been put to death, and the three hundred thousand men of the northern army under Meng Tian lost their general, so that the frontier command had nobody to move when trouble came. Once the rising was under way, Chen Sheng sent Zhou Wen west into Guanzhong, Wu Chen with Zhang Er and Chen Yu north into the lands of Zhao, and Han Guang toward Yan, while Qin Jia and Kong Fu each gathered a following in the region of the Si river, and envoys of Chen Sheng went out to the counties to announce the rising. The way in which a single night raid spread into a net is written into the distribution of these names.
kits: 卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔是公元前七世紀中期希臘世界最完整的頭盔形制：整片青銅鑄成，覆住頭頂、顱骨、臉頰與後頸，只在前方留一對杏形眼孔與一道鼻樑，兩側加護頰，頂上起冠脊以插翎羽，內側以皮帶與襯墊固定在頭上。希臘人先用它把重裝步兵的正面防護推到極致，代價是視野只剩正前方的一條縫，戴上它的人不能獨自作戰，只能靠密集的方陣與身旁的同袍互相遮蔽，所以它在公元前五世紀重裝步兵改革之後便被阿提卡式、伊利里亞式那種露出整張臉的頭盔取代，隨著馬兵與輕步兵興起，全覆面頭盔在希臘戰場上退場。時隔四百多年，公元前二〇九年的楚地與這種頭盔毫無關係：九百名戍卒隨身只有矛、戟與短劍，絕大多數沒有金屬甲胄，起義軍甚至「斬木為兵，揭竿為旗」，把削尖的木棍與竹竿當成長兵與旗幟。秦軍的裝備則完全是另一個技術體系：皮甲、札甲與銅甲片，銅製弩機的弩，成束的箭鏃，長柄戈與矛，單軛雙輪的兵車，車上四人各司其職；攻城用雲梯、巢車與楯車，運輸靠牛車，糧食沿泗水、淮水與汝水轉運。楚地水網密布，起義者又大量徵用漁船與民船充作軍船，這是義軍能沿陳郡水道迅速鋪開的一個技術原因。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is the most complete helmet form of the Greek world of the middle seventh century BC: cast in one piece of bronze, it covered the crown, the skull, the cheeks and the back of the neck, leaving in front only a pair of almond-shaped eye openings and a nasal ridge, with cheek pieces added at the sides and a crest along the crown into which feathers could be set, and it was fixed to the head from the inside by leather thongs and padding. The Greeks first carried the protection of the face to its extreme in it, and the price was a field of vision reduced to a slot directly ahead; the man who wore it could not fight alone and could only be covered by the man in the dense phalanx beside him, which is why, after the reform of the heavy infantry in the fifth century BC, it was replaced by types such as the Attic and the Illyrian helmet that left the whole face bare, and as cavalry and light infantry came to the fore the enclosing helmet left the Greek battlefield. More than four centuries later, the lands of Chu in 209 BC had nothing to do with such a helmet. The nine hundred conscripts carried only spears, halberds and short swords, and the great majority had no metal armour at all; the insurgents even cut wood for weapons and raised bamboo poles for banners, sharpening the sticks and using them as long pikes and as flags. The equipment of the Qin army belonged to a completely different technical system: leather armour, lamellar armour and bronze plates; crossbows with bronze trigger mechanisms; arrows in bundles; long-shafted ge and spears; war chariots with a single draught pole and two wheels, carrying four men with four separate duties; scaling ladders, tower carts and mantlets for the siege; ox carts for transport, with grain moved along the Si, the Huai and the Ru rivers. The lands of Chu were a web of waterways, and the insurgents pressed large numbers of fishing boats and river craft into service as warships, which is one of the technical reasons why the rebel columns could spread so quickly along the waters of the commandery of Chen.
tactics: 起義的過程只有幾天，卻是一套設計得很好的爆發。大澤鄉遇雨，道路斷絕，期限將至，按秦律失期當斬，沒有人能走脫，陳涉、吳廣正是在這個無路可退的時刻決定舉事。他們先在夜裡作聲勢：魚腹藏帛、上書「陳勝王」，篝火狐鳴「大楚興，陳勝王」，使全營以為是鬼神的指示；天亮之後，眾人的議論已經轉向「陳涉、吳廣」兩個名字。接著吳廣當眾自請為屯長、故意辱罵激怒尉，尉果然笞打，吳廣拔劍殺尉，陳涉協助殺第二名尉，兩人奪得兵符、召集全營，自稱將軍，才真正動手。攻大澤鄉沒有遇到成建制的抵抗，守兵與鄉里都無法集合，義軍一舉拿下，隨即收兵進軍蘄縣，再沿泗水與淮水向西北直取陳郡治所淮陽，一路上「行收兵」，隊伍由九百人膨為數萬。整個攻勢的技術核心只有三點：突發、夜間的先手，以及把道路上的鄉里捲進隊伍。缺點也同樣清楚：沒有後方、沒有城防、沒有糧秣儲備，一佔陳郡就分兵四路，把剛剛得來的爆發力分散掉，這也是秦將章邯得以各個擊破的技術前提。
tacticsEn: The rising itself lasted only a few days, but the outbreak was well designed. The rain caught the column at Daze, the roads were cut, the deadline was closing, and under Qin law a missed deadline was death with no one able to slip away; it was in this moment, when there was no way out, that Chen Sheng and Wu Guang decided to rise. They first made a show of it at night: a strip of silk with the words 'Chen Sheng, king' hidden in the belly of a fish, and a fire of brushwood with the fox's cry, 'Chu shall rise, Chen Sheng is king', so that the whole camp took it for a sign from the spirits; by morning the talk of the men had already turned to the two names of Chen Sheng and Wu Guang. Then Wu Guang openly asked to be made company commander and deliberately insulted the officer to anger him; the officer did beat him, and Wu Guang drew his sword and killed him, and Chen Sheng helped kill the second officer; the two took the tokens of command, called the whole camp together, called themselves generals, and only then did they strike. The attack on Daze township met no organised resistance; the garrison and the villagers could not be assembled, and the rebels took it in one push, then gathered their men and marched on the seat of Qi county, then struck north-west along the Si and the Huai toward the seat of the commandery of Chen at Huaiyang, gathering men as they came, the column swelling from nine hundred to tens of thousands. There were only three points to the technical core of the offensive: surprise, the initiative taken at night, and the drawing of the people of the road into the column. The defects were just as clear: no rear area, no fortifications, no stores of grain, and once Chen was taken the force was split into four columns, scattering the momentum it had just won. That scattering was also the technical precondition for the Qin general Zhang Han to beat each column in turn.
data: 可核對的數字都來自《史記·陳涉世家》的內證。起義的戍卒是九百人，隸屬屯戍漁陽的序列，集合地點在泗水郡境內；起義時間是秦二世元年七月，即公元前二〇九年七月。起義軍起事之後「行收兵」，到陳郡治所時已有「車六七百乘，騎千餘，卒數萬人」；秦弩一具可發矢一，車一乘通常載三人，作戰車則為四人，義軍的車兵與騎兵比例，說明隊伍在行軍途中已把沿途的車輛與馬匹一併收編。距離方面，大澤鄉在泗水之濱，今屬江蘇宿遷一帶，至陳郡治所淮陽約五百里；蘄縣在泗水郡下蔡縣境內，與大澤鄉同處泗水下游；戍卒的目的地漁陽郡在燕地西北，去泗水郡的道路上千餘里，而行軍一日約五十里，遇上雨季泥濘，誤期並非偶然。作為對照，秦朝全國的兵員規模是：蒙恬將三十萬眾北擊匈奴、戍上郡與九原，平定嶺南後發兵五十萬戍五嶺，修阿房宮與驪山陵用刑徒七十餘萬。考古一面，秦始皇陵兵馬俑坑出土實戰車俑數十輛與陶俑數千，並有成組的銅弩機、箭鏃、戈矛與甲片，可與《史記》的數字互相對照。
dataEn: Every checkable figure comes from the internal evidence of the chapter on the House of Chen Sheng in the Records of the Grand Historian. The conscripts who rose numbered nine hundred and belonged to the levy series mustered for the garrison of Youyang, and the place where they were assembled lay inside the commandery of Si. The rising is dated to the seventh month of the first year of the Second Emperor, that is July 209 BC. The insurgents gathered men as they marched, and by the time they reached the seat of the commandery of Chen they had six or seven hundred carts, more than a thousand horsemen and tens of thousands of foot. A Qin crossbow sent a single bolt with the squeeze of its trigger, a cart normally carried three men and a fighting chariot four, and the proportion of chariots to cavalry in that column shows that the rebels had already taken over the carts and the horses of the road as they came. As for distances: Daze township stood on the bank of the Si river, in what is now the region of Suqian in Jiangsu, some five hundred li from the seat of the commandery of Chen at Huaiyang; Qi county lay within the jurisdiction of Xiacai county in the Si River commandery, in the same lower reach of the river as Daze; and the destination of the conscripts, the commandery of Youyang, lay to the north-west in the lands of Yan, more than a thousand li off along the road, while a column on the march covers about fifty li a day, so a missed deadline in a wet season was no accident. For comparison, the scale of the Qin armed forces was as follows: Meng Tian took three hundred thousand men north against the Xiongnu and garrisoned Shangjun and Jiuyuan; after the pacification of Lingnan fifty thousand men were sent to garrison the Five Ridges; and more than seven hundred thousand convicts were used on the palaces and on the tomb at Lishan. On the archaeological side, the pit of the terracotta warriors at the mausoleum of the First Emperor has yielded several dozen fighting chariot figurines and several thousand infantry figures, together with sets of bronze trigger mechanisms, arrowheads, ge and spears and armour plates, and these can be set against the figures of the Records.
cause: 起義的直接起因只有一句話：失期當斬。七月的大雨把道路泡爛，九百人的隊伍無法按期抵達漁陽，按照秦律，逾期者斬，而秦律同時又把逃亡與私逃視為同等重罪，陳涉、吳廣面前只剩「等死」一條路，「舉大計亦死」的選擇因此不是英雄主義，而是絕境之中的算計，但它確實是中國歷史記載中最徹底的一次「揭竿而起」。往深一層看，秦的統治成本已經壓到社會底線：北面築長城與九原，南面開靈渠、戍五嶺，宮室苑囿與驪山陵的工程用掉刑徒七十餘萬，男子常年被徵，女子不勝其力，粟米布帛不給；郡縣官吏只求考績，急功近利，寬宥的空間被壓到最小。第三層是政治層的自我毀傷：扶蘇、蒙恬被賜死在北方，蒙恬所領的三十萬北軍頓時失去主帥，政令從咸陽傳到鄉里時帶著的是刑罰而不是保護，人人都清楚服從才是唯一的活路。第四層是結構性的：六國被滅不過十數年，舊的貴族、官吏與民間的復仇記憶仍在，郡縣制還沒有時間在民間長出根，一場大雨、一句失期當斬，就足以把整套體系的縫隙暴露在大澤鄉這樣一個小地方。
causeEn: The immediate occasion of the rising can be put in a single phrase: a missed deadline meant death. The rain of July turned the roads to mud, the column of nine hundred could not reach Youyang in time, and under Qin law those who were late were to be executed, while flight and desertion were treated as offences of the same gravity; Chen Sheng and Wu Guang were left with nothing but the wait for death, so the choice of 'to rise in arms is also death' was not heroism but arithmetic at the end of the road, though it was certainly the most complete raising of a bamboo pole recorded in Chinese history. One layer deeper, the cost of Qin government had been pressed down to the floor of society: the wall and the camps of Jiuyuan in the north, the Lingqu channel and the Five Ridges in the south, and the works on the palaces, the hunting parks and the tomb at Lishan, which consumed more than seven hundred thousand convicts, with men away from their fields year after year and women unable to bear the strain, and grain and cloth not enough to give. The officials of the commanderies and counties cared only for their reports and pushed for quick results, and the room left for leniency was reduced to the smallest possible measure. The third layer was political self-mutilation: Fusu and Meng Tian had been put to death in the north, the three hundred thousand men of the northern army under Meng Tian lost their general at one stroke, so that the orders reaching the countryside from Xianyang carried punishment rather than protection, and everyone understood that obedience was the only road to survival. The fourth layer was structural: the six kingdoms had been destroyed a mere ten-odd years before, the memory of the old nobles, the old officials and the revenge of the people was still alive, the commandery-and-county system had not yet had time to grow roots among the villages, and so one season of rain and one phrase about the missed deadline were enough to open the seams of the whole system in a place as small as Daze township.
impact: 這場起義的結果雖然短暫，但它改變了秦朝崩解的整個過程，也改變了中國歷史講述王朝更替的方式。第一，它把秦軍的裝備優勢與編制優勢從不可動搖變成可被利用的對象：秦以兵數與兵器之利維持的秩序，被一支沒有甲胄的鄉民武裝在陳郡掀開一個口子；秦廷從此把主要兵力用於對付起義，而不是對付北方的匈奴，兩面作戰的結構就此形成。第二，它提供了中國歷史上一個可複製的模板：陳涉在陳郡自立為楚王、號「張楚」，給了起義者一種在秦的郡縣體系之外的權威形式，後來趙地、燕地、齊地、楚地的響應者幾乎都沿用同一套做法，設王、設將軍、發號令、分兵略地。第三，它把「王侯將相寧有種乎」變成了亂世的通行話語，把賤民可以為王的念頭放進了政治想像之中。第四，它把秦軍的細節推入考古的視野：兵馬俑坑的實戰車俑、銅弩機與甲片，讓後人第一次看見秦的車、弩、戈在同一編制裡怎樣配合；睡虎地秦簡所存郡縣公文與徵發文書，則讓後人讀到像大澤鄉這樣的基層徵發到底怎樣運作。從公元前二〇九年七月算起，秦朝只剩下兩年。
impactEn: The rising itself was short-lived, but it altered the whole process by which the Qin came apart, and it altered the way Chinese history tells the story of dynastic change. First, it turned the superiority of the Qin in equipment and in organisation from something unassailable into something that could be used against it: an order held together by weight of numbers and by quality of arms was torn open in the commandery of Chen by a body of village armed men who had no armour, and the Qin court from then on spent its main force against the rebels rather than against the Xiongnu in the north, and the structure of fighting on two fronts took shape. Second, it supplied Chinese history with a template that could be copied: Chen Sheng set himself up in the commandery of Chen as king of Chu under the title Zhangchu, giving the insurgents a form of authority outside the commandery-and-county system of the Qin, and the answerers in Zhao, in Yan, in Qi and in Chu very nearly all followed the same pattern, setting up kings, setting up generals, issuing orders and splitting the force to seize districts. Third, it turned the cry 'are kings, marquises, generals and ministers born of a special breed?' into the common currency of troubled times, and put the idea that a common man might become king into the political imagination. Fourth, it brought the details of the Qin army within reach of archaeology: the fighting chariot figurines, the bronze trigger mechanisms and the armour plates of the terracotta pit allow later scholars to see for the first time how the chariot, the crossbow and the ge worked together within one establishment, and the Qin slips from Yunmeng preserve the documents of the commanderies and counties, so that later readers can see how a levy of the kind raised at Daze was actually put into motion. Counting from July 209 BC, the Qin had two years left.
result: 大澤鄉這一役的結果極為明顯：九百人的屯卒在幾天之內殺尉奪旗、攻下鄉、攻下縣，旬月之間以數萬之眾攻入陳郡治所淮陽，陳涉自立為楚王，號「張楚」，四處分兵略地，秦朝的郡縣體系在楚地一度失靈。這是秦朝開國十五年來最嚴重的一次地方崩潰。短期的勝負也在那一年裡揭曉：秦廷派章邯出關迎擊西進的周文，先在曹陽擊破，再回師攻陳，陳涉敗走，途中死於下城父，張楚隨之瓦解，陳郡重歸秦軍之手。但起義的火種並未熄滅：趙地、燕地、楚地、齊地的起義軍在各地繼續集結，兩年後在鉅鹿重創秦軍主力，秦二世被逼死，劉邦率軍入關，秦朝終結。就大澤鄉一役而言，結果是雙重的：義軍在爆發力上完勝，在編制、後方與補給上完敗；秦廷守住了陳郡，卻在兩年內失去了整個帝國。起義者當時能拿得出手的，只有那面插在削尖木竿上的旗。
resultEn: The affair at Daze township produced a very plain result. A column of nine hundred conscripts, in the space of a few days, killed the officers and took the banners, took the township and took the county seat, and within a month entered the seat of the commandery of Chen at Huaiyang with tens of thousands of men; Chen Sheng set himself up as king of Chu with the title Zhangchu, split his force to seize districts, and the commandery-and-county system of the Qin failed for a time in the lands of Chu. It was the gravest local collapse the Qin had suffered in the fifteen years since its founding. The short-term outcome was settled within that same year: the court sent Zhang Han out of the passes to meet Zhou Wen marching west, broke him first at Caoyang, and then turned back and attacked Chen; Chen Sheng was defeated and withdrew and was killed on the way at Xiachengfu, the Zhangchu regime fell apart, and the commandery of Chen came back into the hands of the Qin army. But the fire of the rising did not go out: the insurgents in Zhao, in Yan, in Chu and in Qi went on gathering, and two years later they broke the main Qin army at Julu, the Second Emperor was forced to death, Liu Bang entered the passes, and the Qin came to an end. As for Daze itself, the result was twofold: the rebels won outright in suddenness and lost outright in organisation, in rear area and in supply; the Qin court saved the commandery of Chen and lost the whole empire within two years. All that the insurgents could show for it was a banner on a sharpened pole of wood.
